title: Error Recovery
description: Agent classifies errors and chooses appropriate recovery branches

steps.content: Run the test suite and fix any failures
steps.annotation: A task that will likely encounter errors requiring recovery

steps.content:
FAIL src/auth.test.ts
  - token expiry test: Expected 3600, received 7200
  - refresh token test: Timeout after 5000ms
Error: 2 tests failed.
steps.annotation: Tool result contains errors -- recovery system classifies them

steps.content:
[Recovery] Error classified: assertion_failure (token expiry)
[Recovery] Error classified: timeout (refresh token)
[Recovery] Branch: retry_with_fix for assertion, increase_timeout for timeout
steps.annotation: Errors are classified before recovery -- different types get different strategies
Continuation reason: 'retrying because assertion value mismatch' -- model investigates
Found the mismatch -- token expiry is 7200 but test expects 3600
Fix applied after explicit recovery reason

steps.content: [Recovery] Retry count: 1/3 for test suite. Continuing with fix.
steps.annotation: Hard limit on retries -- bounded recovery prevents infinite loops
Second recovery branch: increased timeout for slow refresh token test
Both recovery branches resolved the failures

steps.content: All tests pass. Fixed the token expiry value and increased the test timeout for the refresh token test.
steps.annotation: Recovery kept the system moving -- each failure had an explicit reason and a bounded strategy
